name: Roque de los Muchachos — MAGIC and CTAO-North
notes: geometry:magic-array-point and geometry:ctao-north-lst1-point share the exact same coordinate -- expected to raise the validator's geometry-duplicate-shape warning; both experiments genuinely occupy this same approximate patch and are not resolved to finer precision this session.

Overpass (OpenStreetMap) was unreachable for the whole of this research session -- an OSM trace distinguishing the MAGIC-I/MAGIC-II/LST-1 pads (which the brief's own leads suggested, noting Roque is 'often mapped') could not be attempted. See worklog.

The commonly cited value 28°45'43"N 17°53'24"W for MAGIC and ~100 m for LST-1's distance from it were found via multiple secondary sources this session but could not be confirmed against a primary source fetched directly (every attempt to fetch a MAGIC/LST technical paper returned no coordinate text) -- not used, flagged as an unverified candidate in the worklog.

summary.plain: The mountaintop observatory on La Palma, Canary Islands, hosting the MAGIC gamma-ray telescopes and the CTAO-North site (including the LST-1 prototype).
summary.technical: One local map for facility:roque-de-los-muchachos-observatory, shared by experiment:magic and experiment:ctao (CTAO-North). Both are drawn at the same approximate campus point (precision_m 500) because no source fetched this session gives separate decimal coordinates for the MAGIC pads versus the CTAO-North/LST-1 site, matching the existing site record's own documented limitation.
